decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1. The proposed  two storey flank and rear  extension would, by reason of its  excessive size, position, appearance and  in relationship  to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the outlook and residential  amenities of adjoining occupiers  and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development) and H3.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, House Extension Guidelines.  

  2. The proposal  fails to provide sufficient onsite car parking and is likely to give rise to conditions which are prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and highway safety.   The proposal is therefore contrary to policy T 2.5 (Parking and Servicing Facilities) of the Unitary Development Plan and policy T 1.4 ( car and cycle parking and servicing Facilities) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two storey side & rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
